REPAIR ROUND 1 of TASK-006 (repair_rounds_used 0 -> 1). Independent review 8a402362 verdict FAIL with three live findings; the MANAGER independently reproduced all three with its own hands (copied and ran the reviewer's out-of-repo probes itself) rather than trusting the verdict, and confirmed the FAIL is correct.

Verified positives (re-confirmed): gate 6/6 PASS exit 0, --expect-red exit 1, archived baseline 0/6 exit 1, tsc --noEmit exit 0, all 10 candidate snapshot hashes match; the gate is genuinely hardened (no process.env read; five prior false-green classes excluded); and manual constraints (a)-(f) all hold for the real guard - REQ-002's core mechanism is sound.

FINDING 1 - REQ-001 is only half fixed, the user-visible symptom survives. Recovery clears data.queued on the flowStore copy, but flowStore is NOT persisted (flowStore.ts has no persist/createJSONStorage at all), so at recovery time that write is a no-op. The copy that survives a restart is the PERSISTED canvasStore (canvasStore.ts:150-159, name "next-creator-canvases"), and updateNodeQueuedState returns early for the active canvas (queueStore.ts:433). App.tsx:154 setNodes(nodes) then reloads the stale queued=true into flowStore, which ImageGeneratorNode.tsx:215 canRun reads. Manager repro output: after recovery job.status=error 节点不存在, canvasStore data.queued=true, and after simulating setNodes canRun=false. The gate cannot see this because case A pre-populates flowStore BEFORE importing queueStore (queue-regression.mjs:388-398) and asserts only that copy (:414-415); it never seeds or inspects canvasStore and never models App setNodes, and its job assertion passes for the wrong reason (the job errors 节点不存在 instead of executing). Race checked honestly: it self-heals only if queueStore hydration loses to canvasStore by more than one React render; default module order lands in the locked branch (stable at App-load delays 0/50/100/200/900/1200ms).

FINDING 2 - NEW permanent lock introduced by the guard: the very REQ-001 symptom, now reachable by ordinary clicking. Most severe. The new contract makes enqueue return an empty string on rejection, but both production callers (useImageGeneratorExecution.ts:63 and :76) IGNORE the return value and unconditionally write {queued:true,status:"idle"} at :86-90. The executor clears queued only when a job STARTS (imageGenerationExecution.ts:265-272) and NOT on success (:414-423), so a rejection arriving after the last job started leaves no active job to clear the flag, and the node is permanently 排队中/disabled. Restart does not help because the flag lives in the persisted canvas copy while the queue has no queued job for recovery to handle. Manager repro (deterministic): n=2, concurrency=2 -> capture the enabled-button window (active=1, queued=false, canRun=true) -> click -> guard rejects (same-node jobs 2 -> 2) while the hook still writes queued=true -> after all jobs end active=0, queued=true, canRun=false. User's only escape is deleting the node.

FINDING 3 - guard is canvas-blind. hasActiveJobForNode (queueStore.ts:106-108) and batchChains (:237) key on nodeId only and ignore job.canvasId, while duplicateCanvas (canvasStore.ts:111-117) copies nodes preserving every node.id. Manager repro: canvas X click (n=2) -> X jobs 2; switch to canvas Y and click (n=2) -> Y jobs 0, i.e. a legitimate generation is silently rejected. Combined with finding 2, the canvas Y node is also permanently marked queued.

LOW 4 - latent batch-chain desync: module-level batchChains carries an unenforced invariant; if a batch loop were interrupted mid-way a later identical-shape click could be misread as a continuation (reviewer measured 3 extra jobs when forced). Not currently reachable because the loop is synchronous and cannot throw; batchChains is also never pruned or reset.

LOW 5 - scripts/queue-regression.selfcheck.mjs now reports 21/27 (6 baseline-relative failures). Expected once the fix coexists with pre-fix baseline assertions, but it means the "assertions have teeth" evidence is no longer directly reproducible against this candidate without pinning the pre-fix revision. This is a harness/baseline decision for the manager, not a coder task.

REPAIR SCOPE: fix findings 1-3 in src/stores/queueStore.ts and, as needed, src/hooks/useImageGeneratorExecution.ts (both are allowed_paths). Keep gate cases A-F green. Do NOT modify scripts/** (the gate is protected and TASK-005-owned). The gate is DECLARED INSUFFICIENT for findings 1-3, so the repair MUST be validated by end-to-end chain reasoning plus out-of-repo probes, NOT by the gate alone. Reviewer suggested direction (manager verified feasibility by reading the code): (1) clear the flag on the persisted canvas copy too (drop or relax the canvasId===activeCanvasId early return) and/or make waitForCanvasReady actually wait for active-canvas nodes to appear in flowStore instead of returning on _hasHydrated; (2) make the hook honour the empty-string contract (only write queued:true when at least one job was admitted) or have enqueue clear the marker itself on rejection; (3) key the guard by canvasId+nodeId. Constraints preserved: no new dependencies, no UI change, no node data field-semantics change, task identity/budget/clock/allowed_paths unchanged. Deadline 2026-09-28T09:24:59Z.
